description: This file defines a SessionProvider class managing user session state within a Flutter application, including tokens, user info, and routing logic.

classes.name: SessionProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier class that manages session tokens, user data, and route navigation for authentication purposes.

methods.name: attachRouter
methods.description: Attaches a GoRouter instance to facilitate navigation upon session events.

methods.name: isAuthenticated
methods.description: Returns true if a valid access token exists, indicating authenticated session.

methods.name: isAdmin
methods.description: Indicates if the current user has administrative privileges.

methods.name: setSession
methods.description: Stores session tokens and user info, then notifies listeners.

methods.name: updateAccessToken
methods.description: Updates the stored access token, typically after refresh, then notifies listeners.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Clears session data, notifies listeners, and redirects to login route.

methods.name: onUnauthorized
methods.description: Handles unauthorized API responses by triggering logout.
